Seswenna Restates Loyalty}}{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}} *[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] *[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] *[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]][[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]][[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] *[[Eriadu Authority]] *[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] *[[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]'' *[[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] }} '''Sluis Van''' was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sluissi]] race and the location of the famous [[Sluis Van Shipyards]]. ==Description== {{Quote|The Sluis sector is a large expanse of sparsely populated space, renowned for its mineral resources and processing facilities. Its primary system, Sluis Van, maintains a formidable shipyard for construction and maintenance.|HoloNet News|}} [[File:Sluissi-TUR.png|thumb|left|180px|Sluissi, the native species of Sluis Van]] Sluis Van was a world located along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. It was the capital of the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the site of an extensive [[Sluis Van Central space station|deep-space docking facility]] and [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]], the largest and most impressive in the area. The docking station was defended by perimeter [[battle station]]s, while the shipyards were managed by an outer system defense network as well as the [[Sluis Control]]. The ruler of Sluis Van was called a [[khedive]], while the [[Sluis Van Congregate]] held a considerable influence.{{JournalCite|2|Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant}} ==History== ===Early history=== {{Quote|Not only were the shipyards that encircled the planet destroyed, but we are told that the Sith invaders slaughtered everyone who did not immediately swear allegiance to the apparent leader of the Sith, an unnamed Emperor of whom absolutely nothing is known.|Gnost-Dural|[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]}}
[[File:Sluis_ggw.jpg|thumb|220px|The [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|fall of Sluis Van]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].]]
Sluis Van was discovered by [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] explorers, during the [[Subterra Period]]. The Sluissi were long supporters of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with Sluis Van being home to a vital network of Republic shipyards that were [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|destroyed]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. ===Clone Wars=== {{Quote|As we speak, a fleet of one hundred twenty-six ships, seventy-five of them capital ships, is investing Sluis Van to block any reinforcements from that sector.|Admiral Pors Tonith to Asajj Ventress|''[[Jedi Trial]]''}} Millennia later, during the final years of the Republic, they became disgusted with the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] whom they blamed as being massively corrupt and causing galaxy-wide injustice. The planet was represented in the Galactic Senate by [[Bor Gracus]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' and then [[Corlissi Ludar]], until [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when Sluis Van seceded during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. [[Candobar Inglet]] was the the Sluissi Khedive prior and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the Clone Wars, Sluis Van was located in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space and the Sluis Van shipyards produced starships for the Confederate forces.{{InsiderCite|68|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:7:01 Edition}} However, in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the system was [[Battle of Sluis Van (Clone Wars)|blockaded]] by a massive Separatist fleet to block any Republic reinforcements in the area, particularly during the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]].''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' At the end of the Clone Wars, the Sluis Van system had become a Separatist stronghold. As well as many other Confederate worlds, it was besieged by Republic forces during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. Sluis Van held off the Republic. However, the civilians didn't fare well, as mass-starvation broke out on the planet as a result of the Outer Rim Sieges. ===Galactic Civil War=== During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], Sluis Van was a major [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] shipyard and was heavily guarded. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] under control of [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]]. Sluis Van was [[Battle of Sluis Van (Delvardus campaign)|liberated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Despite the [[Sluis Van Congregate]] not wanting to cut all connections to the Empire, being as it was one of their largest shipyard clients, the planet joined the New Republic several months after the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. [[File:Sluisvan_swkm.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The [[Sluis Van Shipyards]] orbiting Sluis Van]] During the [[Thrawn campaign]], the [[Sluis Van Shipyards]] were one of the main shipyards of the New Republic. The planet was the site of a [[Battle of Sluis Van|battle]] with [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his campaign against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. He attacked 112 stripped-down warships docked over the planet, attempting to capture some of them. Although he failed, Thrawn's forces managed to leave over 40 of the vessels with inoperable control systems. ===Later history=== During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the world and its shipyards were crucial to keeping the New Republic supplied with new warships. Following the [[Battle of Fondor|loss]] of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], additional units of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]], including several carriers, were deployed to the region for added protection, when Sluis Van took over Fondor's operations. Sluis Van went on to be a key world in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], it was feared that its shipyards would be a target for the forces of the newly formed [[Confederation]]. By [[137 ABY]], the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|New Galactic Empire]] under the control of the [[One Sith]] had seized control of Sluis Van. Despite this, the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] remained influential on the planet and in the region. ==Behind the scenes== Sluis Van was named by author [[Timothy Zahn]] after his friend Don Vandersluis.''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]'' The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Sluis sector and, consequently, Sluis Van, in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
